eventTypes.newType.title: New event type
eventTypes.newType.help: Tap a name or type your own. It starts as a copy of the Standard type, and later changes to Standard do not change it. Then change whatever you like.
eventTypes.select.label: Event type
eventTypes.errors.noVans: This food truck has no vans to change.
privateEvents.grid.linkRowLabel: Take orders by private link and QR code
privateEvents.grid.columnTitle: The built-in Private type. It cannot be renamed, moved or deleted.
privateEvents.form.help: Shows on your schedule as “Private event” with only the date and times — never the address, the map or Village Foodie.
privateEvents.form.linkPromise: Guests order by a private link and QR code — you will get them after you save.
privateEvents.form.nameHelp: Guests see this at the top of the order page.
privateEvents.form.previewNote: How it shows on your schedule — no venue, town or postcode.
privateEvents.form.needsTimes: Add the start and end time — a private event taking orders by link needs them.
privateEvents.link.title: Private link and QR code
privateEvents.link.label: Private link
privateEvents.link.newLinkConfirm: Create a new link? The current link stops working immediately, and any QR code you have already printed will also stop working.
privateEvents.link.newLinkHelp: Use this if the link has ended up somewhere it should not. The current link stops working immediately, and printed QR codes stop too.
privateEvents.link.newLinkFailed: The new link was not created.
privateEvents.link.offNotice: Ordering by private link is switched off for this event, so there is no link to share. The event still shows on your schedule as “Private event”.
privateEvents.cards.blurb: Order and pay on your phone. We will call you by name when the order is ready.
privateEvents.noSinglePost: Private events do not get a post of their own — they appear on your weekly poster as “Private event”.
privateEvents.confirmToPrivate: This hides the address and the event from the map. Guests will need the private link to order.
privateEvents.confirmFromPrivate: This makes the event public: its address and pin on the map will show, and the private link will stop working.
